mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through cheaper corporate financing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to valuation expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% or mean return is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates collapsing consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25pp over 3 months) increase equity discount rates and reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 6.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong labor market and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
regime_hint: strong labor and consumer demand regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized.
